title: SIN scanner invocation omits explicit runtime target
description: Invoking Invoke-SINPatternScanner without -Runtime can produce mixed-scope findings that are noisy for PS7.6-only paths or insufficiently strict for PS5.1 validation gates. CI and automation paths should always set runtime intent.
detection_method: Regex scan for an actual Invoke-SINPatternScanner INVOCATION (preceded by -File or &) without -Runtime. Join-Path/path-string/log-message references are not invocations and are intentionally not matched (FP reduction 2026-06-18).
preventionRule: Automation and CI calls must pass -Runtime explicitly to match intended target engine policy.
remedy: Set explicit runtime: -Runtime PS51 for strict compatibility gates; -Runtime PS7 for PS7.6-only workloads; -Runtime Both for governance sweeps.
